per_window.ps-ns: unresolved. The one relaxation study (15N R1/R2/NOE of the two-domain D1D2 construct) was read only as an abstract: a short inter-domain linker stretch has large-amplitude motion linked to domain-domain mobility (CIN1D1-J1, r1, other construct, no residues). Fast motion inside domain 1 is search_insufficient (J4).
per_window.us-ms: search_insufficient (J5). No exchange measurement exists in the rows; the missing-peak annotations in the RelaxDB set have no source explanation.
per_window.undetermined: SAXS of D1D2 (thick envelope at the domain boundary, J2, r2) and of full-length Cin1 (loosely packed repeat domains, J3, r3) support inter-domain flexibility in longer constructs; both abstract-only and without a rate.

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Not measured: no row describes the isolated domain-1 construct, and the only relaxation study (two-domain D1D2, read as an abstract) reports large-amplitude motion in a short inter-domain linker without residues, rates or a µs-ms test, so nothing in the evidence shows or excludes µs-ms exchange in domain 1.
questions_for_gina: Is the RelaxDB CIN1D1 set the domain-1 part (residues 1-65) of the D1D2 relaxation data of Mesarich et al. 2012 (2LHT)? If so, the D1D2 rows describe the deposited sample and the inter-domain linker may fall partly inside the entry.
Can the full text of doi:10.1016/j.bbapap.2012.06.015 be obtained to identify the linker residues and any exchange-broadened domain-1 amides?
protein_summary.buffer_note: All three rows are abstract-only, so no buffer, temperature or field is known for any dynamics measurement; the 2LHT structure deposition gives pH 6.2 and 298 K for its sample. The measured constructs (D1D2, full length) are longer than the 65-residue entry, so no row sets a verdict for the entry construct. Zero-hit method searches did not even retrieve the known Cin1 paper and count as search_insufficient.
